import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 2000010;
    static final long Mod = 1000000007L;
    static final long mod = 998244353L;
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static long n, idx, ans, sum[] = new long[10];
    static List<Long>[] v = new ArrayList[10];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long readLong(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        long x = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (ch == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                x = ch - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1 || !Character.isDigit(ch))
                break;
            x = x * 10 + (ch - '0');
        }
        return sign * x;
    }

    static long cmin(long x, long y) {
        return Math.min(x, y);
    }

    static long cmax(long x, long y) {
        return Math.max(x, y);
    }

    static long MOD(long x) {
        return ((x % mod) + mod) % mod;
    }

    static void dfs1(long x, int len) {
        idx++;
        v[len].add(MOD(idx - x));
        sum[len] = (sum[len] + v[len].get(v[len].size() - 1)) % Mod;
        if (len == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            dfs1(x * 10 + i, len + 1);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * B + (B - 1) <= n && x * B * 10 > n) {
            long now = idx;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                int sz = v[i].size();
                long d = MOD(now - x * (long) Math.pow(10, i));
                int pos = lowerBound(v[i], mod - d);
                ans = (ans + d * sz + sum[i] - mod * (sz - pos)) % Mod;
                idx += sz;
            }
            return;
        }
        idx++;
        ans = (ans + MOD(idx - x)) % Mod;
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            dfs2(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = readLong(br);
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        idx = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(i);
        }
        System.out.println((ans + Mod) % Mod);
    }
}
